blocks.text: Qoida juda oddiy va istisnosiz: predlogdan (in, at, of, for, about, with, without, before, after, by, instead of ...) keyin fe'l kelsa, u **-ing** shaklida bo'ladi. Sababi: predlogdan keyin ot turishi kerak, -ing esa fe'lning «ot» shakli. Qizil kitobda buni sifatlar bilan ko'rganmiz: tired **of waiting** (→ qizil kitob, 112-dars). O'zbekchada ham predlog o'rnidagi ko'makchi yoki qo'shimcha «-ish» otiga qo'shiladi: chiq**ishdan oldin**, so'ra**masdan**, shikoyat qil**ish o'rniga**, gapir**ishga** usta. Bu darsda eng ko'p uchraydigan predloglar, **by -ing** ning ma'nosi va eng katta tuzoq — **to** predlog bo'lgan holatlar (look forward **to seeing**).

rows: Shikoyat qilish o'rniga bizga yordam bering.

blocks.text: Ko'p sifat va otlar ma'lum predlog bilan yuradi, undan keyin fe'l -ing bo'ladi: **interested in**, **good at**, **bad at**, **fed up with**, **tired of**, **afraid of**, **capable of**, **responsible for**, **keen on**, **famous for**, **proud of**, **worried about**; otlar: **the idea of**, **the chance of**, **the risk of**, **a way of**, **a reason for**, **thanks for**, **sorry for**, **in favour of**. Qaysi predlog kerakligini so'z bilan birga yodlang (to'liq ro'yxat → 129–131-darslar). Ba'zi sifatlar ham to, ham predlog + -ing bilan kelib, ma'no o'zgaradi: afraid **to** / afraid **of** -ing (→ 66-dars).

items.text: I'm not very **good at remembering** names, so I write them down.
items.translation: Ismlarni **eslab qolishga** unchalik **usta emasman**, shuning uchun yozib qo'yaman.

items.text: Thank you **for coming** all this way to see us.
items.translation: Bizni ko'rish uchun shuncha yo'l **bosib kelganingiz uchun** rahmat.

items.text: She's **proud of having** raised four children on her own.
items.translation: U to'rt farzandni yolg'iz **voyaga yetkazganidan faxrlanadi**.

blocks.text: **before -ing** — «-ishdan oldin», **after -ing** — «-gandan keyin / -gach». Ular to'liq gapning qisqa varianti: Before **going** to bed = Before **I go** to bed. Rasmiyroq uslubda **after having done** ham ishlatiladi. **on -ing** — rasmiy, «-ishi bilan» (= as soon as): **On arriving** at the hotel, ... Muhim shart: -ing ning egasi asosiy gap egasi bilan bir xil bo'lishi kerak. **After finishing** the report, **I** went home — to'g'ri (men tugatdim, men ketdim). «After finishing the report, the computer crashed» — xato: hisobotni kompyuter tugatmagan! (vaqt predloglari haqida → qizil kitob, 105-dars).

**by + -ing** — natijaga **qanday usul bilan** erishilganini bildiradi: You can improve your English **by reading** every day — «Har kuni kitob o'qib ingliz tilingizni yaxshilashingiz mumkin». O'zbekchada «-ib» ravishdoshi yoki «-ish orqali / -ish yo'li bilan» to'g'ri keladi. Uni ikkita o'xshash qolip bilan adashtirmang: **for -ing** — narsaning vazifasi (a knife **for cutting** bread — non kesish uchun pichoq); **to + fe'l** — odamning maqsadi (I went out **to buy** bread — non olish uchun chiqdim; batafsil → 64-dars).

rows: I got fit **by cycling** to work.
Bu yerga seni ko'rish uchun keldim.

items.text: You can book tickets **by calling** this number or on the website.
items.translation: Chiptalarni bu raqamga **qo'ng'iroq qilib** yoki saytda bron qilishingiz mumkin.

items.text: This little knife is **for opening** letters, not for cutting bread.
items.translation: Bu kichkina pichoq non kesish uchun emas, **xat ochish uchun**.

items.text: She went to the bank **to open** an account for her daughter.
items.translation: U qizi uchun **hisob ochish uchun** bankka bordi.

blocks.text: **without -ing** — «-masdan / -may»: He left **without paying** — «To'lamasdan ketdi». O'zbekchada inkor qo'shimchasi bor, inglizchada esa yo'q: «without not paying» deyilmaydi. **instead of -ing** — «-ish o'rniga». **despite -ing** / **in spite of -ing** — «-ishiga qaramay» (despite dan keyin **of** yo'q!; batafsil → 113-dars). **apart from / besides / as well as -ing** — «-ishdan tashqari», «-ish bilan birga». -ing dan oldin boshqa ega ham kelishi mumkin: **despite** many people **objecting** — «ko'pchilik qarshi chiqqaniga qaramay».

items.text: He answered all the questions **without looking** at his notes.
items.translation: U qaydlariga **qaramasdan** barcha savollarga javob berdi.

items.text: **Instead of going** out, we stayed in and played board games.
items.translation: Tashqariga **chiqish o'rniga** uyda qolib, stol o'yinlari o'ynadik.

items.text: **Despite having** a map, we got lost in the old town.
items.translation: Xaritamiz **bo'lishiga qaramay**, eski shaharda adashib qoldik.

blocks.text: to — predlog bo'lganda: look forward to -ing

**to** ikki xil so'z. Ko'pincha u infinitivning bir qismi: want **to go**, decide **to stay**. Lekin ba'zan u oddiy **predlog** (go **to** London, listen **to** music) — va unda keyin fe'l **-ing** bo'ladi: I'm **looking forward to seeing** you («to see you» — xato!). Shunday iboralar: **look forward to**, **object to** (qarshi bo'lmoq), **in addition to** (... dan tashqari), **when it comes to** (gap ... ga kelganda), **be committed to** (... ga sodiq bo'lmoq), **admit to**, **have no objection to**, **prefer -ing to -ing** (→ 59-dars), **be / get used to** (→ 61-dars). Tekshirish usuli: to dan keyin ot qo'yib ko'ring. I'm looking forward to **the holiday** — mumkin → to predlog → -ing.

items.text: I'm **looking forward to having** a few days off after the conference.
items.translation: Konferensiyadan keyin bir necha kun **dam olishni intiqlik bilan kutyapman**.

items.text: My father **objects to paying** for things he never uses.
items.translation: Dadam hech qachon foydalanmaydigan narsalari uchun **pul to'lashga qarshi**.

items.text: When it **comes to choosing** a laptop, I always ask my cousin.
items.translation: Gap **noutbuk tanlashga kelganda**, doim amakivachchamdan so'rayman.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I'm looking forward to see you.» → I'm looking forward **to seeing** you.; «He left without to say goodbye.» → He left **without saying** goodbye.; «Before to go out, ...» → **Before going** out, ...; «I'm interested to learn» / «interested for learning» → I'm **interested in learning** ...; «Instead to complain, ...» → **Instead of complaining**, ...; «Despite of feeling ill» → **Despite feeling** ill / **In spite of feeling** ill.; «You can learn English by watch films.» → **by watching** films.; «Thank you for help me.» → Thank you **for helping** me.

Eslab qolish: predlog — eshik, undan faqat **ot** o'tadi. Fe'l o'tishi uchun -ing «kiyimini» kiyishi kerak. O'zbekchada «-ish» + ko'makchi (-ishdan oldin, -ish o'rniga, -ishga qaramay) yoki «-masdan» bo'lsa, inglizchada deyarli doim **predlog + -ing**. «Intiqlik bilan kutyapman» → **looking forward to -ing** — to bor, lekin baribir -ing!

rows: I **look forward to hearing** from you.

examples.title: Adjective + preposition + -ing: **good at**, **tired of**
examples.description: Sifat + predlog + -ing: interested in, good at, fed up with, afraid of, responsible for, keen on, capable of, famous for, tired of, worried about.

sentences.text: Are you **interested in joining** our book club? We meet every second Thursday.
sentences.translation: Kitobxonlar klubimizga **qo'shilishga qiziqasizmi**? Har ikkinchi payshanba uchrashamiz.

sentences.text: Aziz is very **good at fixing** computers, so everyone in the office asks him for help.
sentences.translation: Aziz **kompyuter tuzatishga juda usta**, shuning uchun ofisdagilarning hammasi undan yordam so'raydi.

sentences.text: I'm **fed up with waiting** for the council to repair our street.
sentences.translation: Hokimiyat ko'chamizni ta'mirlashini **kutaverib, toqatim toq bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: Madina is **afraid of driving** on the motorway, so she always takes the old road.
sentences.translation: Madina avtomagistralda **mashina haydashdan qo'rqadi**, shuning uchun doim eski yo'ldan yuradi.

sentences.text: Who is **responsible for checking** the equipment before each flight?
sentences.translation: Har bir parvozdan oldin uskunalarni **tekshirishga** kim **mas'ul**?

sentences.text: Jasur isn't very **keen on going** to the gym, but he loves football.
sentences.translation: Jasur **sport zaliga borishga unchalik ishqiboz emas**, lekin futbolni yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: Thanks to her training, Nilufar is now **capable of running** a half marathon.
sentences.translation: Mashg'ulotlari tufayli Nilufar endi yarim marafon **yugurishga qodir**.

sentences.text: Bukhara is **famous for making** beautiful embroidered cloth called suzani.
sentences.translation: Buxoro so'zana deb ataladigan chiroyli kashtali matolar **tikish bilan mashhur**.

sentences.text: Sarah got **tired of living** in a tiny flat and moved to the suburbs.
sentences.translation: Sara kichkina kvartirada **yashashdan charchab**, shahar chetiga ko'chib ketdi.

sentences.text: Our neighbours are **worried about losing** their jobs when the factory closes.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarimiz zavod yopilganda **ishsiz qolishdan xavotirda**.

examples.title: **before** / **after** / **on** + -ing
examples.description: Vaqt: before -ing — «-ishdan oldin», after -ing (after having done) — «-gandan keyin», on -ing — rasmiy «-ishi bilan». -ing egasi = gap egasi.

sentences.text: Always read the contract carefully **before signing** it.
sentences.translation: Shartnomani **imzolashdan oldin** doim diqqat bilan o'qib chiqing.

sentences.text: **After graduating** from university in Samarkand, Dilnoza moved to London.
sentences.translation: Samarqanddagi universitetni **bitirgach**, Dilnoza Londonga ko'chib ketdi.

sentences.text: Please wash your hands **before touching** any of the food on the table.
sentences.translation: Stoldagi ovqatlarga **tegishdan oldin**, iltimos, qo'lingizni yuving.

sentences.text: **After spending** three hours in traffic, we finally arrived at the hotel.
sentences.translation: Tirbandlikda uch soat **o'tkazgandan keyin** nihoyat mehmonxonaga yetib keldik.

sentences.text: Oliver always does some stretching **before going** for a run.
sentences.translation: Oliver yugurishga **chiqishdan oldin** doim badanini cho'zib oladi.

sentences.text: **On arriving** at the airport, passengers must go straight to passport control.
sentences.translation: Aeroportga **yetib kelishi bilan** yo'lovchilar to'g'ri pasport nazoratiga borishlari shart.

sentences.text: Think twice **before posting** photos of your children online.
sentences.translation: Bolalaringiz suratlarini internetga **joylashdan oldin** ikki marta o'ylang.

sentences.text: **After having worked** in a bank for ten years, Tom decided to become a teacher.
sentences.translation: Bankda o'n yil **ishlagandan keyin** Tom o'qituvchi bo'lishga qaror qildi.

sentences.text: Did you check the oven **before leaving** the house? — I think so.
sentences.translation: Uydan **chiqishdan oldin** pechni tekshirdingmi? — Shunday shekilli.

sentences.text: Bekzod felt much better **after talking** to his old teacher about his problems.
sentences.translation: Muammolari haqida eski ustozi bilan **gaplashgandan keyin** Bekzod o'zini ancha yaxshi his qildi.

examples.title: **by** + -ing: how to do something
examples.description: by -ing — natijaga qanday usul bilan erishilgani. O'zbekchada «-ib» yoki «-ish orqali».

sentences.text: You can save a lot of money **by cooking** at home instead of eating out.
sentences.translation: Tashqarida ovqatlanish o'rniga uyda **ovqat qilib**, ancha pul tejashingiz mumkin.

sentences.text: Kate improved her English **by watching** British TV series with subtitles.
sentences.translation: Keyt subtitrli Britaniya seriallarini **ko'rib**, ingliz tilini yaxshiladi.

sentences.text: The thieves got in **by climbing** through the bathroom window.
sentences.translation: O'g'rilar ichkariga hammom derazasidan **tirmashib kirishgan**.

sentences.text: How did you get the job? — **By sending** my CV to every company in the city!
sentences.translation: Ishni qanday topdingiz? — Shahardagi har bir kompaniyaga rezyumemni **yuborib**!

sentences.text: We can reduce traffic **by making** public transport cheaper and more reliable.
sentences.translation: Jamoat transportini arzonroq va ishonchliroq **qilish orqali** tirbandlikni kamaytirish mumkin.

sentences.text: Jasur paid for his studies **by working** in a café every evening.
sentences.translation: Jasur har kuni kechqurun kafeda **ishlab**, o'qishining pulini to'ladi.

sentences.text: You can turn the computer off **by holding** down this button for five seconds.
sentences.translation: Bu tugmani besh soniya **bosib turib**, kompyuterni o'chirishingiz mumkin.

sentences.text: Many people relax **by listening** to music on the way home.
sentences.translation: Ko'p odamlar uyga ketayotib **musiqa tinglab** dam oladi.

sentences.text: The company cut costs **by moving** its office out of central London.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya ofisini Londonning markazidan **ko'chirib**, xarajatlarni qisqartirdi.

sentences.text: **By leaving** home ten minutes earlier, you'll avoid the worst of the traffic.
sentences.translation: Uydan o'n daqiqa erta **chiqib**, eng og'ir tirbandlikdan qutulasiz.

examples.title: **without** + -ing
examples.description: without -ing — «-masdan / -may». O'zbekchada inkor qo'shimchasi bor, inglizchada not qo'yilmaydi.

sentences.text: Emma left the party **without saying** goodbye to anyone.
sentences.translation: Emma hech kim bilan **xayrlashmasdan** ziyofatdan ketib qoldi.

sentences.text: Don't sign anything **without reading** the small print first.
sentences.translation: Mayda harflar bilan yozilganlarni **o'qimasdan** hech narsani imzolamang.

sentences.text: He drove all the way from Tashkent to Fergana **without stopping** once.
sentences.translation: U Toshkentdan Farg'onagacha bir marta ham **to'xtamasdan** haydab bordi.

sentences.text: How can you learn a language **without practising** speaking?
sentences.translation: Gapirishni **mashq qilmasdan** tilni qanday o'rganish mumkin?

sentences.text: Bekzod borrowed my car **without asking** me first, which really annoyed me.
sentences.translation: Bekzod mendan **so'ramasdan** mashinamni olib ketdi, bundan rosa jahlim chiqdi.

sentences.text: Our team finished the project **without going** over budget.
sentences.translation: Jamoamiz loyihani byudjetdan **chiqmasdan** yakunladi.

sentences.text: She listened to the whole story **without interrupting**, which was unusual for her.
sentences.translation: U butun voqeani **gapni bo'lmasdan** tingladi, bu unga xos emas edi.

sentences.text: You can't get into the building **without showing** your ID card.
sentences.translation: Shaxsiy guvohnomangizni **ko'rsatmasdan** binoga kira olmaysiz.

sentences.text: Madina passed her driving test **without making** a single mistake.
sentences.translation: Madina haydovchilik imtihonidan birorta ham **xato qilmasdan** o'tdi.

sentences.text: Never go into the mountains **without telling** someone where you're going.
sentences.translation: Qayerga ketayotganingizni birovga **aytmasdan** hech qachon tog'ga chiqmang.

examples.title: **instead of**, **despite**, **apart from** + -ing
examples.description: instead of -ing — «-ish o'rniga», despite / in spite of -ing — «-ishiga qaramay», apart from / besides / as well as -ing — «-ishdan tashqari».

sentences.text: **Instead of complaining** about the weather, let's find something to do indoors.
sentences.translation: Ob-havodan **shikoyat qilish o'rniga**, uyda qiladigan biror ish topaylik.

sentences.text: **Despite feeling** ill, Sarah went to the meeting and gave her presentation.
sentences.translation: O'zini yomon **his qilishiga qaramay**, Sara yig'ilishga borib, taqdimotini qildi.

sentences.text: Why don't you walk to work **instead of taking** the car? It's only two kilometres.
sentences.translation: Nega ishga **mashinada borish o'rniga** piyoda bormaysiz? Atigi ikki kilometr-ku.

sentences.text: **Apart from swimming**, what other sports do you do?
sentences.translation: **Suzishdan tashqari** yana qanday sport bilan shug'ullanasiz?

sentences.text: Tom failed the exam **in spite of studying** every night for a month.
sentences.translation: Bir oy davomida har kecha **o'qiganiga qaramay**, Tom imtihondan yiqildi.

sentences.text: **Instead of buying** a new dress, Nilufar had her old one altered.
sentences.translation: Yangi ko'ylak **sotib olish o'rniga**, Nilufar eskisini qayta bichtirib oldi.

sentences.text: The plan was approved **despite** many people **objecting** to it.
sentences.translation: Ko'p odamlar **qarshi chiqqaniga qaramay**, reja tasdiqlandi.

sentences.text: **As well as working** full-time, Jasur is studying for a master's degree.
sentences.translation: Jasur to'liq stavkada **ishlash bilan birga**, magistraturada ham o'qiyapti.

sentences.text: Aziz spent the evening playing games online **instead of revising** for his exam.
sentences.translation: Aziz imtihonga **tayyorlanish o'rniga** kechqurunni onlayn o'yin o'ynab o'tkazdi.

sentences.text: **Besides being** a talented doctor, Kate is also a very good pianist.
sentences.translation: Keyt iste'dodli **shifokor bo'lishdan tashqari**, juda yaxshi pianinochi ham.

examples.title: Noun + preposition + -ing: **the idea of**, **thanks for**
examples.description: Ot + predlog + -ing: thanks for, sorry for, the idea of, the chance of, the risk of, a reason for, a way of, in favour of, no intention of, the thought of.

sentences.text: Thank you very much **for helping** me with the move last weekend.
sentences.translation: O'tgan dam olish kuni ko'chishda menga **yordam berganingiz uchun** katta rahmat.

sentences.text: I like **the idea of working** abroad, but I'd miss my family.
sentences.translation: Chet elda **ishlash g'oyasi** menga yoqadi, lekin oilamni sog'inardim.

sentences.text: Is there any **chance of getting** a ticket for tonight's concert?
sentences.translation: Bugungi konsertga chipta **olish imkoni** bormi?

sentences.text: Sorry **for being** so late — my train was cancelled.
sentences.translation: Juda **kechikkanim uchun** uzr — poyezdim bekor qilindi.

sentences.text: There's a real **risk of losing** customers if we raise our prices again.
sentences.translation: Narxlarni yana oshirsak, mijozlarni **yo'qotish xavfi** chindan ham bor.

sentences.text: Most local people are **in favour of building** a new hospital.
sentences.translation: Mahalliy aholining ko'pchiligi yangi shifoxona **qurilishini yoqlaydi**.

sentences.text: What's your **reason for leaving** your current job?
sentences.translation: Hozirgi ishingizdan **ketishingizning sababi** nima?

sentences.text: Writing things down is a good **way of remembering** new words.
sentences.translation: Yozib qo'yish — yangi so'zlarni **eslab qolishning** yaxshi **usuli**.

sentences.text: Bekzod has **no intention of apologising** — he thinks he did nothing wrong.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning **kechirim so'rash niyati yo'q** — u o'zini hech qanday ayb qilmagan deb hisoblaydi.

sentences.text: The **thought of speaking** in front of five hundred people terrified Madina.
sentences.translation: Besh yuz kishi oldida **gapirish haqidagi fikrning o'zi** Madinani dahshatga soldi.

examples.title: **to** as a preposition: **look forward to**, **object to**
examples.description: Bu iboralarda to — predlog, shuning uchun undan keyin -ing: look forward to, object to, in addition to, when it comes to, committed to, admit to, no objection to.

sentences.text: I'm really **looking forward to seeing** you in Edinburgh next month.
sentences.translation: Kelasi oy Edinburgda siz bilan **ko'rishishni intiqlik bilan kutyapman**.

sentences.text: We **look forward to hearing** from you at your earliest convenience.
sentences.translation: Imkon qadar tezroq **javobingizni kutib qolamiz**.

sentences.text: Many residents **object to paying** more for parking outside their own homes.
sentences.translation: Ko'p aholi o'z uyi oldidagi avtoturargoh uchun ko'proq **pul to'lashga qarshi**.

sentences.text: **In addition to teaching**, Professor Brown writes books for children.
sentences.translation: Professor Braun **dars berishdan tashqari** bolalar uchun kitoblar ham yozadi.

sentences.text: When it **comes to cooking** plov, nobody in our family can beat my uncle.
sentences.translation: Gap **palov damlashga kelganda**, oilamizda hech kim amakimga teng kelolmaydi.

sentences.text: Are you **looking forward to starting** your new job on Monday?
sentences.translation: Dushanba kuni yangi ishingizni **boshlashni intiqlik bilan kutyapsizmi**?

sentences.text: I **don't object to working** on Saturdays, as long as I get a day off in the week.
sentences.translation: Hafta ichida bir kun dam olsam, shanba kunlari **ishlashga qarshi emasman**.

sentences.text: The company is **committed to reducing** its carbon emissions by half.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya uglerod chiqindilarini ikki baravar **kamaytirish majburiyatini olgan**.

sentences.text: Jasur finally **admitted to cheating** in the maths exam.
sentences.translation: Jasur nihoyat matematika imtihonida **ko'chirganini tan oldi**.

sentences.text: Kate **has no objection to sharing** her notes with the rest of the class.
sentences.translation: Keyt konspektlarini sinfdoshlari bilan **bo'lishishga qarshi emas**.

examples.title: Mixed: work, study and travel
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: after, without, for, look forward to, by, instead of, despite, interested in, before, good at, way of — bitta gapda bir nechta qolip.

sentences.text: **After moving** to Manchester, Aziz got used to the rain surprisingly quickly.
sentences.translation: Manchesterga **ko'chgandan keyin** Aziz yomg'irga hayratlanarli darajada tez ko'nikdi.

sentences.text: You won't pass the exam **without doing** some serious revision.
sentences.translation: Jiddiy **takrorlamasdan** imtihondan o'ta olmaysiz.

sentences.text: Thank you **for inviting** us — we're **looking forward to meeting** your family.
sentences.translation: Bizni **taklif qilganingiz uchun** rahmat — oilangiz bilan **tanishishni intiqlik bilan kutyapmiz**.

sentences.text: Sarah lost five kilos **by walking** to work **instead of driving**.
sentences.translation: Sara ishga **mashinada borish o'rniga piyoda yurib**, besh kilo ozdi.

sentences.text: **Despite having** very little money, the students organised a fantastic festival.
sentences.translation: Pullari juda oz **bo'lishiga qaramay**, talabalar ajoyib festival tashkil qilishdi.

sentences.text: Is Dilnoza **interested in applying** for the manager's position?
sentences.translation: Dilnoza menejer lavozimiga **ariza topshirishga qiziqadimi**?

sentences.text: **Before booking** a hotel online, always read the reviews from other guests.
sentences.translation: Internetda mehmonxona **bron qilishdan oldin** doim boshqa mehmonlarning sharhlarini o'qing.

sentences.text: Oliver is **good at explaining** complicated ideas **without using** technical words.
sentences.translation: Oliver murakkab g'oyalarni texnik so'zlar **ishlatmasdan tushuntirishga usta**.

sentences.text: What's the best **way of getting** from the airport to the city centre?
sentences.translation: Aeroportdan shahar markaziga **borishning** eng yaxshi **yo'li** qanday?

sentences.text: Bekzod apologised **for forgetting** our meeting and offered to buy lunch.
sentences.translation: Bekzod uchrashuvimizni **unutgani uchun uzr so'radi** va tushlikka mehmon qilishni taklif qildi.
